answer: Make the registry a nebula: auditors drift on random orbits, so no clone ring can predict which lane will inspect it. Each identity locks its stake in a glacier vault that melts one layer per epoch; a thawed layer cannot be refrozen for a second face, so N shells need N full vaults, each melting alone, not one shared block. Standing flows only from an oasis: a slow spring rationed one cup per epoch per funder, so a farm queuing N cups waits N epochs while a lone agent drinks at once. If one cup is poisoned, the oasis dries for the whole funder line and every glacier above it cracks.
